_source: Original NoöPunk case material (#897). Mechanics are vanilla CWN; the fiction is 1974 psychedelic retrofuture Helsinki.
title: The Lakkahaltia Signal

locations.name: Your flat, Kallio
locations.subtitle: Rain on the window; the radio will not stop humming.

locations.name: UNSA Headquarters
locations.subtitle: A concrete slab above the tram lines. Somewhere a telex is printing.

actions.label: Ask Romppainen to join the party

locations.name: Hakaniemi market hall
locations.subtitle: Fish, amphetamines, and a woman who saw the sky open.

locations.name: Sörnäinen harbour terminal
locations.subtitle: Container cranes move like praying mantises under sodium light.

locations.name: Noetic clinic, Töölö
locations.subtitle: The wallpaper is avocado. The doctor's eyes are not quite synchronised.

locations.name: Lakkahaltia warehouse
locations.subtitle: A mission location. The signal is strongest behind the freezer door.

actions.label: Confront what is behind the freezer door

clues.witness: The sky over Lakkahaltia opened for eleven seconds at 03:14.
clues.terminal: The harbour terminal logged an inbound container with no ship attached.
clues.doctor: Dr. Vainio treated three agents for the same dream in one week.
clues.device: The transmitter is tuned to a frequency that is not in the radio band.
